sections.title: Teams of agents vs teams of agents
sections.summary: Three team models with different reward personalities (striker: kills first; guardian: survival first; pack: fully shared team rewards and the zone) trained against each other, past snapshots and the bots for 12 rounds, about 1.5 hours on 4 CPU cores, under the competitive rules: control zone with reinforcements, weapon heat, 20 respawns, friendly fire, 384 px guns. All three started from the champion team model, which the bots beat 98% of the time under these rules: its spray-and-camp style kept its guns overheated 46% of the time. After an overheat penalty was added at round 4, the striker broke away and finished level with the bots. On 60 fresh battles it won 42% (± 6%) against the bots and 87% against the starting champion.

charts.alt: Elo per league member over 12 rounds with the bots fixed at 1000: the striker climbs from about 700 to 988; pack and guardian hover around the starting champion's 500 to 700.
Round 12 win rates: bots and striker are even (48/52%); both beat pack, the champion and the guardian 85 to 98% of the time; pack and the champion are even; the guardian loses to everyone.

sections.title: A trained team beats the bot team (classic rules)
sections.summary: One shared PPO policy flies all five blue ships against the built-in bots, each ship getting half of its teammates' kill and death rewards. Starting from the single-seat agent, it won 90% of battles after 2M ship-steps and every evaluation battle from 3M on (about 35 minutes on 4 CPU cores). Checked on 50 battles it had never seen, the 3M model still won 98%.

chart.alt: Team training progress: blue's win rate climbs from 45% to 100% and its average kill margin from -0.8 to +18.8 over 4M ship-steps; the all-bot team sits at 50% and -0.8.

sections.title: One trained agent among bots (classic rules)
sections.summary: A PPO agent flies blue ship 0; the other nine ships are the built-in bot. After 3.5M training steps it beats the bot playing the same seat, on 50 battles it never trained on. On its own it doesn't help a whole team: five copies win about as often as five bots, which is why the team training above was needed.

chart.alt: Training progress: the agent's average reward and kills per death rise past the bot's between 3M and 3.5M steps.
